summary: Iteration 5 backend testing for hard cut-over from Emergent Google OAuth to password auth (JWT+bcrypt). Rebuilt tests from scratch (old iter1-4 tests removed). 21/21 tests pass after fixing 2 real production bugs in the backend. Covered: seed-admin login, JWT/cookie issuance, /auth/me, brute-force lockout (429 after 5 fails), change-password (strength rules + must_reset toggle), onboarding status+complete, 5 project types schema, project create/patch with extended fields, xlsx template + xlsx & csv bulk import (with error row handling), user invite -> temp password -> first-login change-password, dashboard-config GET/PATCH, site_manager RBAC scope on /units, and regression on expenses two-stage approval, revenue-targets, exports, dashboard summary.

critical.issue: 500 Internal Server Error caused by MongoDB ObjectId `_id` leaking into response. `doc = u.model_dump(); await db.users.insert_one(doc)` mutates doc to inject `_id`, then FastAPI serialization crashes with `TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable`. FIXED by adding `doc.pop('_id', None)` before returning.
Security bug: `password_hash` was returned in the response body (bcrypt hash leaked to admin UI). FIXED by adding password_hash exclusion to find_one projection.

action_items: Two production bugs were fixed directly in server.py (see updated_files). Please review the fixes.
Consider centralising the User serialization (a single helper `serialize_user(doc)` that pops both `_id` and `password_hash`) to prevent recurrence — several endpoints project these fields ad-hoc.
Login endpoint returns cookie with SameSite=None + Secure (correct for cross-site preview). Frontend must send `credentials: 'include'` on fetch calls.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 2172 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, projects, units, expenses, onboarding, exports).

POST /projects and PATCH /projects/{id} both accept ProjectCreate (PATCH is thus non-partial: caller must resend all fields or defaults will overwrite). Consider a ProjectUpdate model with all Optional fields for true partial patches.

Login rate-limiter (`db.login_attempts`) never expires the lock document; after 15 min the code correctly ignores the stale `locked_until`, but the doc stays with `count>=5` forever. On success `delete_one` runs but on continued failure new counts keep incrementing. Consider a TTL index or reset window.

`get_dash_config` reads `user.dashboard_config` from the User model but the model type is `Optional[dict]` and it's only refreshed via /auth/me — a PATCH followed by GET works only because `get_current_user` re-queries the DB every request (which is good but expensive).
`gen_temp_password` produces 12 chars with guaranteed upper/lower/digit/symbol — matches strength rule (min 10). Good.
Onboarding `has_units` only counts globally (`db.units.count_documents({})`); if all units belong to a soon-to-be-deleted project, the flag stays true. Fine for MVP but worth noting.

No admin data was mutated except that /onboarding/complete flipped admin.onboarding_completed=true (which is idempotent and expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid after this iteration. The seed admin still has must_reset_password=true — do NOT rely on that being flipped by this suite (it wasn't; only onboarding_completed was set). If you need to test the admin change-password path, either (a) use a freshly seeded admin (delete users.find_one({email:ADMIN_EMAIL}) and restart backend to auto-seed) or (b) invite a new user and test change-password on them (that's what TestChangePasswordFlow already does). Brute-force lockout writes to db.login_attempts — delete that collection if you need a clean slate.

bug_1_create_user_500.reproduction: POST /api/users with any valid admin body -> 500
bug_1_create_user_500.rca: line 800: `doc = u.model_dump(); await db.users.insert_one(doc)`. motor injects an ObjectId at doc['_id'] after insert. The endpoint then returns `doc` inside a JSON response and FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize ObjectId, raising ValueError.
bug_1_create_user_500.fix_applied: Added `doc.pop('_id', None)` alongside the existing `doc.pop('password_hash', None)` before returning.

bug_2_patch_user_leaks_hash.reproduction: As admin, PATCH /api/users/{id} with any field -> response body contains password_hash (bcrypt).
bug_2_patch_user_leaks_hash.rca: line 825 fetched with projection `{_id: 0}` only — did not exclude password_hash.
